ModMetaData.name: Setosa's Power Tools
ModMetaData.author: Setosa, true_mogician
ModMetaData.description:
This mod adds several new power tools to the game. These are industrial level items and can be unlocked via Machining research and then built at the machining table. Currently available tools: Chainsaw, Power Saw, Auger, Electric Chisel, Jackhammer, Electric Drill, Nail Gun. Work stat boost can be adjusted in the mod settings by choosing between two presets (Normal and Nerfed) or customizing each value individually. Compatible with Combat Extended and Melee Animation.
Credits to Simmin and their original mod, Power Tools, on which this mod is based. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2440250887
